description:
§4.12 (S445 review F2) — a `` that only becomes the file's top-level program through a component expansion (`const Svc =
…
` + ``) has never had its configuration read, so the compiler refuses it with E-PROGRAM-CONFIG-UNREAD rather than guessing. Before S445 it compiled at exit 0 and its server functions answered anonymous callers (reviewer-executed: 200 "s3cret").
rationale: §4.12: 'a top-level `<program>` that only exists after component expansion has never had its configuration read, and SHALL be a compile error (`E-PROGRAM-CONFIG-UNREAD`), never a guessed configuration.'
